# ISummerGovernorErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/errors/ISummerGovernorErrors.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerGovernorErrors

Interface defining custom errors for the SummerGovernor contract


## Errors
### SummerGovernorInvalidProposalThreshold
Error thrown when the proposal threshold is invalid


```solidity
error SummerGovernorInvalidProposalThreshold(uint256 proposalThreshold, uint256 minThreshold, uint256 maxThreshold);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposalThreshold`|`uint256`|The invalid proposal threshold|
|`minThreshold`|`uint256`|The minimum allowed threshold|
|`maxThreshold`|`uint256`|The maximum allowed threshold|

### SummerGovernorProposerBelowThresholdAndNotGuardian
Error thrown when a proposer is below the threshold and not a guardian


```solidity
error SummerGovernorProposerBelowThresholdAndNotGuardian(address proposer, uint256 votes, uint256 threshold);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`proposer`|`address`|The address of the proposer|
|`votes`|`uint256`|The number of votes the proposer has|
|`threshold`|`uint256`|The required threshold for proposing|

### SummerGovernorUnauthorizedCancellation
Error thrown when an unauthorized cancellation is attempted


```solidity
error SummerGovernorUnauthorizedCancellation(address caller, address proposer, uint256 votes, uint256 threshold);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`caller`|`address`|The address attempting to cancel the proposal|
|`proposer`|`address`|The address of the original proposer|
|`votes`|`uint256`|The number of votes the proposer has|
|`threshold`|`uint256`|The required threshold for proposing|

### SummerGovernorInvalidTrustedRemote
Error thrown when the trusted remote is invalid


```solidity
error SummerGovernorInvalidTrustedRemote(address trustedRemote);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`trustedRemote`|`address`|The invalid trusted remote|

### SummerGovernorNotHubChain
Error thrown when the chain id is invalid


```solidity
error SummerGovernorNotHubChain(uint256 chainId, uint256 hubChainId);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`chainId`|`uint256`|The invalid chain id|
|`hubChainId`|`uint256`|The valid chain id|

### SummerGovernorCannotExecuteOnHubChain
Error thrown when an attempt is made to execute on the hub chain


```solidity
error SummerGovernorCannotExecuteOnHubChain();
```

### GovernorNotSet
Error thrown when the governor is not set


```solidity
error GovernorNotSet();
```

### SummerGovernorInvalidCaller
Error thrown when the caller is not the rewards manager


```solidity
error SummerGovernorInvalidCaller();
```

### SummerGovernorInvalidPeerArrays
Error thrown when the peer arrays are invalid


```solidity
error SummerGovernorInvalidPeerArrays();
```
